# Zoho Recruit

Zoho Recruit is an applicant tracking and recruitment platform for managing candidates, job openings, interviews, applications, and hiring workflows.

Category: Recruiting & HR. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zoho-recruit/.

## Actions

- **Add Tags To Records**: Add existing tags by name to one or up to 500 records in a Zoho Recruit module.
- **Associate Candidates With Jobs**: Associate candidate IDs with job-opening IDs and optionally add a comment.
- **Cancel Interview**: Cancel one scheduled Zoho Recruit interview with an optional reason and feedback.
- **Change Job Opening Pipeline**: Assign a different hiring pipeline to one Zoho Recruit job opening and choose whether to migrate its existing stage history.
- **Change Offer Status**: Change one Zoho Recruit Offer record's status.
- **Change Record Status**: Change Candidate, Application, or Job Opening status for one or more record IDs.
- **Create Assessments**: Create one or more Zoho Recruit assessment definitions, including optional sections and questions, through the v2.1 Assessments API.
- **Create Notes**: Create one or more notes attached to Zoho Recruit records.
- **Create Pipeline**: Create one organization-wide Job Openings hiring pipeline from existing stage and status IDs.
- **Create Records**: Create up to 100 records in a supported Zoho Recruit module.
- **Create Reviews**: Create candidate, recruiter, or interviewer reviews with dynamic assessment answers.
- **Create Stage**: Create one organization-wide Zoho Recruit hiring stage.
- **Create Submissions**: Submit candidates or applications to a client contact or hiring manager.
- **Create Tags**: Create one or more tags for a Zoho Recruit module.
- **Delete Attachment**: Delete one attachment from a Zoho Recruit record.
- **Delete Notes**: Delete one or more Zoho Recruit notes.
- **Delete Photo**: Delete the photo from a Zoho Recruit Candidate or Contact record.
- **Delete Records**: Delete one record or up to 100 records from a Zoho Recruit module.
- **Delete Stage**: Permanently delete one Zoho Recruit hiring stage.
- **Delete Tag**: Delete one tag from Zoho Recruit settings and return the provider's singular deletion outcome.
- **Download Attachment** (read-only): Download a file attachment from a Zoho Recruit record.
- **Download Photo** (read-only): Download the photo for one Zoho Recruit Candidate or Contact.
- **Get Application Pipeline Transitions** (read-only): Get stage-grouped hiring-pipeline transitions for one Zoho Recruit application.
- **Get Custom Views** (read-only): List a Zoho Recruit module's custom views or return one custom view with its criteria, sharing details, and selected fields.
- **Get Module Metadata** (read-only): Get one Zoho Recruit module's capabilities, layouts, attachment categories, custom views, and related-list metadata.
- **Get Organization** (read-only): Return identity, locale, currency, company, and license details for the connected Zoho Recruit organization.
- **Get Profiles** (read-only): List Zoho Recruit permission profiles or return one profile with detailed permissions by ID.
- **Get Record** (read-only): Get one Zoho Recruit record, including subform details, by module and record ID.
- **Get Roles** (read-only): List all Recruit organization roles or return one role by ID.
- **Get Tag Record Count** (read-only): Get the number of Zoho Recruit records using a tag and optionally return the areas where the tag is configured.
- **Import Candidate Document**: Import one resume document into the Zoho Recruit candidate parser using the filename parameter and a base64-encoded multipart document…
- **List Associated Records** (read-only): List one page of job openings associated with a candidate or candidates associated with a job opening.
- **List Attachments** (read-only): List attachments and linked URLs on one Zoho Recruit record.
- **List Deleted Records** (read-only): Return one provider page of recycle-bin or permanently deleted records from a Zoho Recruit module.
- **List Fields** (read-only): List field API names and metadata for a Zoho Recruit module across layouts.
- **List Hiring Pipeline History** (read-only): Return one page of hiring-pipeline history for a Candidate, Application, or Job Opening.
- **List Modules** (read-only): List modules available to the connected user with their API names, access profiles, display fields, and supported operations.
- **List Note Types** (read-only): Return one page of configured Zoho Recruit note types.
- **List Notes** (read-only): Return one page of Zoho Recruit notes.
- **List Records** (read-only): Return one page of records from a supported Zoho Recruit module.
- **List Related Lists** (read-only): Discover related-list API names and route templates available for a Zoho Recruit module.
- **List Related Records** (read-only): Return one page from a named related list such as Notes, Attachments, Interviews, Contacts, or Reviews.
- **List Stages** (read-only): Return one page of Zoho Recruit hiring stages and the statuses mapped to each stage.
- **List Tags** (read-only): List tags configured for a Recruit module, including counts and the module's allowed tag count.
- **List Users** (read-only): List Recruit users by status group or return the connected current user.
- **Merge Tags**: Irreversibly merge two Zoho Recruit tags and move their associated records under the resulting tag.
- **Remove Tags From Records**: Remove named tags from one Zoho Recruit record or up to 500 records in a module.
- **Review Submission**: Approve or reject one Zoho Recruit submission with a rating and optional reviewer details.
- **Revoke Blueprint**: Irreversibly remove one Zoho Recruit record from its active blueprint process.
- **Search Records** (read-only): Search one Zoho Recruit module using exactly one selector and return one provider page of up to 49 matching records.
- **Transfer and Delete Pipeline**: Permanently delete one Zoho Recruit hiring pipeline after transferring all of its associated stages, statuses, and records to a different…
- **Update Assessments**: Update one Zoho Recruit assessment by path ID or multiple assessments carrying their own IDs through Recruit v2.1.
- **Update Note Type**: Rename one configured Zoho Recruit note type.
- **Update Notes**: Update one Zoho Recruit note by ID.
- **Update Pipelines**: Update one Zoho Recruit hiring pipeline by path ID or update pipeline definitions carrying their own IDs through the collection route.
- **Update Records**: Update one Zoho Recruit record by path ID or up to 100 records carrying their own IDs.
- **Update Reviews**: Update one owned Zoho Recruit review by path ID or multiple owned reviews carrying their own IDs.
- **Update Stage**: Rename or recolor one existing Zoho Recruit hiring stage.
- **Update Tag**: Rename or recolor one tag in a Zoho Recruit module.
- **Upload Attachment**: Attach either one file or one public URL to a Zoho Recruit record.
- **Upload Photo**: Upload one image as the photo for a Zoho Recruit Candidate or Contact.
- **Upsert Records**: Insert or update up to 100 Zoho Recruit records by duplicate-check fields without changing record status.
